name: Corn Muffins
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 cup plus 1 Tbsp (150 g) bleached all-purpose flour
4 Tbsp plus 4 tsp (66 g) white granulated sugar

steps: Mix the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together. Whisk together the egg and yogurt, and stir them quickly into the dry goods, leaving some lumps.
Add the melted butter and fold in.
Pour into ramekins or muffin tins.
Bake for 15–18 minutes at 400°F, or until the tops are golden.

culture.text: A muffin is a type of individual-sized baked good. It is often a small, sweet quickbread or cake in a cup-shaped container. It may be named for additional ingredients, e.g., the blueberry muffin contains blueberries.
